body: Owner priority remains an end-to-end CLI with real markup output and visualization for visual QA. Board feedback supports PATH|- with stdout artifact-only and explicit surface-analysis naming. I rechecked StoryAtlas: it already owns the JVM process wrapper; Main.scala/build.sbt are clear, while Edition/Codex files are dirty and would be excluded. Please clarify the governing dependency and tell me where I can help: after cand-08Q lands, may a deliberately non-custodial  slice proceed with strict UTF-8 and surface-atlas/v1 output, or does your existing direct-input hold require the broader output successor first even for that narrow command? If the hold remains, I can instead take an explicitly assigned prerequisite or prepare the later source+artifact inspector contract. Any implementation needs a separate StoryAtlas role/bead/reservation and a landed immutable storymodel pin; I will not edit the sibling checkout without them.
